method: Actual full production composer with unchanged runtime/test source. Sandbox30 plots at mixed fixed growth stages, default owned buildings/animals; RNG7142 and Date.now frozen only for paired scene state. CSS viewport/DPR1 and touch emulation on desktop PC; Best quality keeps baseline shadow/postprocess policy. Normal presets/camera/player pose fixtures; no accepted animal alterations. Google webfonts loaded from page-declared anonymous files. Optional perf overlay hidden, normal HUD kept. No phone performance or wall-clock pacing claim.
